title: I FEEL THE PULL

lines.text: At night I lay, and I begin to cry
And my mind just failed to say, exactly why,
I cant explain with tongue or pen,
It must be God, here in my soul,
I feel the pull, I hear the call
And I know His spirit is moving me
He speaks to me and I agree,
Lord please come and take control.
I want to hear the word and with each line and phrase,
For He was drawing me to give a higher praise
Theres a deep call to the deep like a great magnet pulling me.
I knows for sure that Ill reach the goal

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
At night I lay, and I begin to cry
And my mind just failed to say, exactly why,
I cant explain with tongue or pen,
The Spirits wooing deep within,
It must be God, here in my soul,
Cause I feel the pull.

[Chorus]
I feel the pull, I hear the call
And I know His spirit is moving me
To give my all.
He speaks to me and I agree,
Lord please come and take control.
I feel the pull.

[Verse 2]
I want to hear the word and with each line and phrase,
For He was drawing me to give a higher praise
Theres a deep call to the deep like a great magnet pulling me.
I knows for sure that Ill reach the goal
Cause I feel the Pull.
